page_title: BHA 0-3 ARS | Brighton v Arsenal 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Ben White (Arsenal) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
90+3' Pascal Gross (Brighton) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
90+2' The resulting corner from Pascal Gross (Brighton) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

90+2' Joao Pedro (Brighton) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Brighton can continue in their attacking effort.
90+1' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
90+1' The ball is cleared after Simon Adingra (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
90' Declan Rice (Arsenal) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
89' Here is a change. Martin Odegaard is going off and Mikel Arteta gives the last tactical orders to Fabio Vieira (Arsenal).
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) will replace Kai Havertz.
86' 0 - 3 GOAL - 0:3! Kai Havertz found Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
86' Brighton players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
82' Pascal Gross (Brighton) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
81' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Simon Adingra (Brighton). The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brighton.
79' William Saliba (Arsenal) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
79' The ball possession at the moment is 49:51.
76' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Danny Welbeck and he is replaced by Ansu Fati (Brighton).
76' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
72' Substitution. Oleksandr Zinchenko makes way for Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal).
72' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is caught offside!
71' Declan Rice (Arsenal) prepares to take a corner kick.

71' Great solo effort by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) as he tricks his way past two defenders before firing in a drive from long range towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper is alert and makes a save. The referee blows his whistle, Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
71' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Raya, who smothers the ball.
69' Some great controlled play and passing from Brighton. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
64' Substitution. Bukayo Saka did his best and is replaced by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal).
64' The referee signals a substitution. Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is brought on as a substitute for Gabriel Jesus.
63' Substitution. Jakub Moder leaves the pitch and is replaced by Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton).
63' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Julio Enciso is replaced by Joao Pedro (Brighton).
62' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Jorginho picks out Kai Havertz (Arsenal) with a sweet pass, and he latches on to it deep inside the box and beats the goalkeeper. 0:2.
62' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

58' Julio Enciso (Brighton) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
57' The corner from Pascal Gross (Brighton) is hurriedly cleared.
57' Julio Enciso (Brighton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Brighton will take a corner kick.
56' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
56' Ben White (Arsenal) tackles a bit over-zealously and John Brooks blows for a foul. Brighton get a free kick.
55' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
54' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) works the corner short.

54' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Bart Verbruggen makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Arsenal.

51' It's a weak and poor shot by Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) as he flashes a first-time shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
51' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
50' Simon Adingra (Brighton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Brighton force a corner. They send men into the box.

48' What a chance that is! Kai Havertz swings the ball into the box, and Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
47' Declan Rice (Arsenal) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

47' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes behind for a corner. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' Julio Enciso (Brighton) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for David Raya as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+8' John Brooks blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+7' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
45+5' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
45+5' Brighton hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
45+3' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
45' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Pascal Gross (Brighton). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

44' Julio Enciso (Brighton) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the top right corner is, however superbly saved by David Raya! The linesman points to the corner flag, Brighton are going to take it.
42' Gabriel (Arsenal) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
38' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) launches a cross from the corner, but Bart Verbruggen is alert to thwart the effort.
38' Ben White (Arsenal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball is out of play and Arsenal manage to earn a corner.
36' The free kick is taken by Pascal Gross (Brighton), but ball is cleared.

36' It looks like Kai Havertz (Arsenal) saw red with that tackle. John Brooks won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Free kick. Brighton will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
36' Simon Adingra (Brighton) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.
33' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen no chance!
33' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
31' Referee John Brooks sees the trip by Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. The referee gives a penalty kick to Arsenal!!
31' Arsenal keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
29' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
28' The game is interrupted now, Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
26' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
24' Simon Adingra (Brighton) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Danny Welbeck, but David Raya displays great awareness to stop him.
23' Gabriel (Arsenal) sends a long ball forward to Oleksandr Zinchenko, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.

22' Gabriel (Arsenal) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
22' Corner kick. Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is ready to send the ball into the box.

21' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Arsenal will take a corner.
21' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) will take the free kick.
21' Julio Enciso (Brighton) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Arsenal are awarded the free kick.
19' John Brooks blows his whistle and it's Ben White (Arsenal) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

17' Simon Adingra (Brighton) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.

16' Kai Havertz does well to cross from a difficult angle and find Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) on the edge of the six-yard box, but his header slips well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
14' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

13' That was a nice football moment. Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Bart Verbruggen guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! The ball goes out of play and Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.

13' A brilliant individual effort! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.

11' Jakub Moder (Brighton) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.

9' Tariq Lamptey races towards the box before laying off to Julio Enciso (Brighton), who picks it up but blazes a shot well over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
9' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
7' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Arsenal.
4' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
4' An attempted cross from Julio Enciso (Brighton) is cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Brighton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
2' Gabriel (Arsenal) latches onto the free kick from Martin Odegaard, but heads just wide of the left post from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
1' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
1' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) commits a rough challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for an infringement. That's a free kick to Arsenal.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Arsenal will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be John Brooks.
